_doc: Files to exclude from /gallery — promotional materials, duplicates, off-topic content. Read by scripts/build-gallery-enrichments.js and merged into public/data/gallery-enrichments.json.excludeMediaKeys, which GalleryContext consumes at load time. Reversible: remove from this file and re-run `node scripts/build-gallery-enrichments.js` to bring an entry back.
_format: Each entry: { mediaKey: string (the part after `/x-` before the extension), reason: string, addedBy?: string }
